name: hand-fist
description: A closed hand with four curled fingers and a thumb across the palm.
useCase: Represent a closed-hand gesture beside a clear label.
misuse: Hand gestures can carry different meanings across cultures. Explain the intended action with text.

16.reason: Complete fingers, thumb and palm fit the shared square drawing frame.

24.reason: Open finger separations and clear palm contours keep the full hand readable at toolbar sizes.
